rows.label: qst620102_msg0001
rows.name:
Mo-mo!! There is such a dazzling,
cool-looking cabinet here, mo!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0002
rows.name:
So this is TIGER! TIGER! It looks fun,
mo!!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0003
rows.name:
You've got a good eye, Nopon Nii-chan,
mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0004
rows.name: Tora's grandpa made it, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0005
rows.name: Amazing, mo!!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0006
rows.name: Can I play it right away, mo?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0007
rows.name:
Of course, mo! But ordinary players
have to pay 100G per play, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0008
rows.name:
No problem, mo. I've got plenty of
money, mo!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0009
rows.name: Then let's play TIGER! TIGER!, mo!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0010
rows.name: Mo-mo~ This is hard, mo~.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0011
rows.name:
Everyone gets taken out quickly at
first, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0012
rows.name:
But if you keep trying, you'll get
better eventually, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0013
rows.name:
And if you clear it, you get a
fabulous prize, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0014
rows.name:
Mo-mooo! My gamer blood is boiling,
mooo!!!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0015
rows.name:
Play as much as you like, mo. Tora and
the others will rest inside, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0016
rows.name:
It's been about two hours... How's it
going?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0017
rows.name: This game is...

rows.label: qst620102_msg0018
rows.name: [ML:Feeling kind=Anger ]It's a trash game, mo!!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0019
rows.name: [ML:Feeling ]Mo-mo!?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0020
rows.name:
TIGER! TIGER! is a masterpiece, mo.
Why do you think it is a trash game,
mo?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0021
rows.name: Pulolo brought 48,000G, mo...

rows.label: qst620102_msg0022
rows.name:
But in just two hours, I'm penniless,
mo!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0023
rows.name:
What else would you call this but a
trash game, mo!?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0024
rows.name: Mo-mo!? You played 480 times, mo!?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0025
rows.name:
That means you died once every 15
seconds, mo. You are way too bad at
it, mo!!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0026
rows.name: Mo-mooo!?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0029
rows.name:
But when I think about it, it was fun,
so I poured 48,000G into it, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0030
rows.name: I don't regret it at all, mo!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0031
rows.name: Really, mo?

rows.label: qst620102_msg0032
rows.name: Actually, I regret it a little, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0033
rows.name:
I only wanted to get the Tank Custom III
prize, mo.

rows.label: qst620102_msg0034
rows.name:
All right, mo. Tora will get that one
and give it to you, mo!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0035
rows.name: Mo-mo! Thank you, mo!

rows.label: qst620102_msg0036
rows.name:
I want Tora's incredible skills to win
the Tank Custom III for me, mo.
